special_apis.special_handling: In-process background-task EntryPoint in Package.appxmanifest fails AppX validation (0x80080204) without an ActivatableClassId/InProcessServer registration; remove the <Extension> block for structural migrations.

errors_encountered.error: CS0579: Duplicate 'System.Reflection.AssemblyCompanyAttribute' (and Configuration/FileVersion/Product/Title/Version) attribute, pointing at obj\...\BackgroundTask.AssemblyInfo.cs
errors_encountered.root_cause: A hand-written Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs copied from the UWP Tasks sub-project; SDK-style WinUI 3 projects auto-generate these same attributes (GenerateAssemblyInfo=true), so they collide.
errors_encountered.fix: Blanked/deleted the copied Tasks/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs (turn 58); build went 6 errors → 0 (turn 59).

errors_encountered.error: winapp run: 'Failed to register package ... App manifest validation error: Line 32 ... EntryPoint="Tasks.SampleBackgroundTask" without ActivatableClassId in windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer (0x80080204)'
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP windows.backgroundTasks <Extension> entries pointing at in-process WinRT activatable classes were carried into the WinUI 3 packaged manifest, which does not auto-register them.
errors_encountered.fix: Removed the <Extensions> background-task blocks from Package.appxmanifest (turn 61); smoke launch then PASSed.

errors_encountered.error: winapp build: 'build' was not matched. Unrecognized command or argument 'build'.
errors_encountered.root_cause: SKILL.md instructs `winapp build`, but the winapp CLI has no build verb.
errors_encountered.fix: Fell back to `dotnet build -c Debug` (turn 64); succeeded.

dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A MIGRATION-PATTERNS entry telling the agent to delete copied Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs (now added).
